title: Deciphering the Dual Scrolls
statement:
Historians discover two ancient manuscript scrolls S1 and S2 containing sequences of uppercase alphabetic runes. To establish their genealogical connection, the historians need to find the length of the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) shared by both manuscripts.

A subsequence is a sequence that can be derived from another sequence by deleting some or no runes without changing the order of the remaining runes.
inputFormat:
First line: String S1.
Second line: String S2.
outputFormat: Print a single integer: the length of the LCS.
constraints:
1 <= len(S1), len(S2) <= 1500
Strings contain only uppercase English letters.
